text:
Cologne’s median asking rent stands at 15.55 €/m², up 6.1 % year‑on‑year and 28.5 % over the last five years, placing the city fourth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 66 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 933 € per month.

The market remains balanced but tight: listings spend an average of 22 days on the market, 36 % are let within a week, and the vacancy rate is just 1.3 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 19.5 %, while mortgage rates sit at 4.09 %.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 16.33 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 15.98 €/m² and 16.72 €/m², implying a further 5 % rise.
